shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && ls && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "dashkit\|grid layout\|drag" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html

grep -n -i "required setup\|styles\|\.css\|DashKitProps\b" README.md | head -20; sed -n '/^### Props/,/^### DashKit config/p' README.md | head -60; ls build; cat package.json | grep -n -A15 '"exports"' | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && sed -n 30,45p package.json; grep -rn "scss\|\.css" build/esm/components/DashKit/*.js build/esm/components/ActionPanel/*.js | head -5; cat build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/index.d.ts

grep -n "SetConfigItem\|AddNewItemOptions\|interface Settings\b\|type Settings\b\|SettingsProps\|MenuItem\b" -A12 typings/*.d.ts | head -90; grep -n "cols\|rowHeight" -r utils/*.js constants/*.js components/GridLayout/*.js | head

grep -rn "cols:\|rowHeight:" --include=*.js . | head; grep -n "AddConfigItem\|type ConfigItem\b\|interface ConfigItem\b" -A12 shared/types/*.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "OverlayCustomControlItem\b" -A12 components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "MenuItems = " -A8 -r constants/*.d.ts

grep -rn "rowHeight\|gridLayout" --include=*.js utils/register-manager.js constants/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "rowHeight: " --include=*.js . | grep -v test | head; grep -n "AddConfigItem" -B2 -A8 typings/config.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "MenuItems" -A8 constants/*.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "ConfigItemData\b" -A6 shared/types/config.d.ts | head -10

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; grep -n "Delete\|onChange\|removeItem" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && for n in ChartColumn Pencil Check ArrowRotateLeft LayoutCellsLarge TextAlignLeft ListUl Heading Gauge CircleCheck Plus Persons ArrowUpRight ArrowDownRight; do [ -f icons/$n.d.ts ] && echo "OK $n" || echo "NO $n"; done; ls icons | grep -i "^layout\|^heading\|^text\b\|^textalign\|^arrowtrend\|^chart" | head -30; cd uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n "theme?\|view?\|size?\|value\|stack" Progress/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "theme?\|size?\|type?" Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -n "view?\|type?\|theme?" Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n "verticalAlign\|wordWrap\|align?" Table/Table.d.ts | head

sed -n 1,32p Progress/types.d.ts | grep -n "Theme\|Size\|text" ; grep -rn "export type CardView\|export type CardTheme\|export type CardType" Card/; grep -n "TableColumnConfig\|id:\|name?\|template?\|width?" Table/Table.d.ts | head -12; ls | grep -i "segment\|radio"; grep -n "export.*configure\|Lang" ../utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "export declare enum Lang\|export type Lang" .. --include=*.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 1,6p uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; cat dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title; grep -n "onUpdate\|content\|checked" uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head; grep -n "options\|onUpdate\|Option" uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head

sed -n 1,6p uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find uikit/build/esm -name "configure.d.ts" | head -2 | xargs sed -n 1,6p; cat dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts | head -25; grep -n "options\|onUpdate\|value" uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | grep -i "controlgroup" -A0 | head; grep -n "interface ControlGroupProps" -A14 uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|disabled" uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -8

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && grep -rn "isMobile" --include=*.js components utils | grep -v test | head -8; grep -n "removeItem\|onChange(" components/DashKit/DashKit.js hooks/useDashKitContextValue.js context/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "removeItem" --include=*.js -l . | head; cat components/GridItem/GridItem.css | head -40
grep -n "removeItem" -A8 hocs/withContext.js | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/src/dashboard && sed -i -E 's/, minW: [0-9]+, minH: [0-9]+\}/}/; s/^        \{\.\.\.kpiPlugin\},$/        kpiPlugin,/' plugins.tsx && sed -i -E 's/, minW: [0-9]+, minH: [0-9]+//' plugins.tsx && perl -0pi -e "s/export const WIDGET_PRESETS: Record<Exclude<WidgetType, 'title'>, Record<string, unknown>> & \{\n    title: Record<string, unknown>;\n\} = \{/export const WIDGET_PRESETS: Record<WidgetType, Record<string, unknown>> = {/" plugins.tsx && grep -n "defaultLayout\|kpiPlugin,\|WIDGET_PRESETS" plugins.tsx; grep -n "AdditionalWidgetLayout" -A4 ../../node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/*.d.ts | head -6

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "\-\-g-spacing" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -5; grep -n "\-\-g-color-base-background\|--g-border-radius-l\b\|--g-color-line-generic\b\|--g-color-text-secondary\b\|--g-color-base-generic\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -6
